description: Angular component for a toggle header UI element with pagination and responsive behavior, including directives, classes, and methods for managing toggle options, pagination, and breakpoint responsiveness.

classes.name: ToggleOption
classes.description: Directive representing an individual toggle option with error handling.

classes.name: _ToggleBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for toggle components, managing toggle options synchronization.

classes.name: ToggleHeaderComponent
classes.description: Main component for toggle header UI with pagination, responsive behavior, and toggle options.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes breakpoint observation and pagination behavior.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up pagination observation after view initialization.

methods.name: trackByHeaderOption
methods.description: Tracks toggle options by their value for Angular's ngFor optimization.

methods.name: handlePaginatorClick
methods.description: Handles click events on pagination controls.

methods.name: handlePaginatorTouchStart
methods.description: Prevents default touch behavior if pagination is disabled in a direction.

methods.name: startObservePagination
methods.description: Starts observing resize events for pagination.

methods.name: removePagination
methods.description: Removes pagination observers and disables controls.

methods.name: scrollHeader
methods.description: Scrolls the toggle header in a specified direction.

methods.name: scrollToToggleOptionValue
methods.description: Scrolls to the selected toggle option.

methods.name: updatePagination
methods.description: Updates pagination enabled state and controls.

methods.name: checkPaginationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if pagination should be enabled based on content width.

methods.name: checkPaginationControls
methods.description: Enables or disables pagination arrows based on scroll position.

methods.name: getMaxScrollDistance
methods.description: Calculates maximum scroll distance based on content width.

methods.name: _scrollTo
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific position within the toggle header.

methods.name: updateToggleHeaderScrollPosition
methods.description: Updates the visual scroll position of the toggle header.
